_comment: Reference tool roster for ambig-SWE SDK sessions. Captured live from claude-agent-sdk ClaudeAgentOptions(tools={'type': 'preset', 'preset': 'claude_code'}, permission_mode='default', strict_mcp_config=True, mcp_servers={}, can_use_tool=<callback>) against claude-agent-sdk 0.2.128 on 2026-07-28. This is the stock default Claude Code toolset with this machine's personal MCP servers (Gmail/Calendar/Drive) excluded via strict_mcp_config, so the roster reflects a standard install rather than this developer's account-specific extras. Every entry below came from the live capture; no tool was added by hand, narrowed, or removed. AskUserQuestion appears in the preset on its own once a can_use_tool callback is registered.
